data.case_title: Copyright infringement warning letter (Abmahnung) demanding €1,180 settlement
data.title: Abmahnung wegen Urheberrechtsverletzung – letzte außergerichtliche Gelegenheit
data.summary: A law firm (Kanzlei Dr. Beispielmann & Coll. Medienrecht) in Düsseldorf sent a copyright-infringement warning letter (Abmahnung) alleging that a film was offered for download via the recipient's internet connection in a file-sharing network. It demands a lump-sum settlement of €1,180.00 by 1 December 2026 to avoid a lawsuit.
data.explanation: A law firm claims a copyrighted film was shared illegally over your internet connection and offers to drop the matter if you pay €1,180 by the stated date. This type of letter can be legitimate but is also a pattern used in abusive or fraudulent mass "Abmahnung" claims, so do not pay immediately. Before transferring any money, it is advisable to have a lawyer (e.g. specialised in media/IT law, or a consumer advice centre) check the claim and the account details. If you do nothing and the claim is genuine, the firm may pursue the matter in court.

items.title: Pay the settlement amount for the alleged copyright infringement

items.consequence: The sender states that their client will not sue if payment is made by the deadline; non-payment could lead to a lawsuit.

warnings: The printed IBAN (DE88 3704 0044 0532 0881 00) does not pass the standard IBAN checksum validation, so verify the account details carefully before sending any money.

This letter uses pressure tactics (a short payment deadline and threat of a lawsuit) typical of both legitimate and abusive mass copyright-warning letters; have a lawyer or consumer advice centre check the claim before paying.
No cease-and-desist declaration (Unterlassungserklärung) is requested if you pay, which is unusual for a genuine copyright warning and worth independent verification.
